name: value-stored-in-an-unknown-property-of-a-dependency-type
description: A value the program stores in a property typed unknown of an object type a dependency declares has left the analysis, because the dependency receives the object and may serialize what the property holds: a request body a callback returns in a constituent of the dependency's request type keeps the data members of its own type. A value stored in a property typed unknown of a type the target declares has been converted to unknown, so it has left the analysis as well and keeps its data members.
